Hi Tharushi 
How are you
Im contacting you on behalf of my relative
He has recently moved to Dubai
He is an orthopaedic surgeon looking out for a place to stay 
Works at Aster Discovery Gardens
Looking out for a clean furnished 1 BHK in close proximity to Aster or atleast a convenient short commute as he doesn’t have his car
Budget is 4000-5500 AED per month 
If water and electricity is provided along with a washing machine then that would be ideal
